title: Compatibility record
description: One place where an app can break on a device: where official material is wrong, silent, or easy to miss.

id.description: Same as the file name without .json.

kind.description: contradiction: official material disagrees with the device or with other official material. undocumented: behaviour no official material mentions. documented-limit: stated by the vendor, and easy to miss. question: not known yet.

claim.description: What official material says. If it says nothing, what an app would reasonably assume. For a question, the question.

actual.description: What happens instead. Not used for a question.

impact.description: What the user or the developer sees.

repro.description: Steps or minimal code, or the path of a probe in this repository.

docs.description: Official material the record is about.

links.description: Discussion that is not evidence, such as where a question was asked.

fixedIn.description: The release that fixed it. Records are kept after a fix: apps on older releases still meet it.

versions.description: Versions in effect when the behaviour was seen. Leave out what is not known.

level.description: reported: someone else's report, linked. runtime: reproduced here in a browser or Node. simulator: reproduced here in the vendor simulator. hardware: reproduced here on the device.

date.description: When it was seen, not when it was written down.

source.description: A URL, or a path in this repository.
